company_name: Qingdao Fuso Refining & Processing Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — Fuso Group specializes in ultra-high purity silica sol, a critical material for silicon wafer polishing in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Qingdao Fuso Refining & Processing Co., Ltd is a leading manufacturer of ultra-high purity silica sol, essential for semiconductor wafer polishing. With nearly 70 years of experience, the company also develops high purity organic acids and fine chemicals, serving various industries including semiconductor and photovoltaic.
capabilities: Ultra-high purity silica sol for silicon wafer polishing

regional_presence.Japan: Fuso Group is headquartered in Japan and has a long history of manufacturing and innovation in the region.
regional_presence.China: The company has production bases in China, contributing to its multinational manufacturing capabilities.
regional_presence.United States: Fuso Group operates in the United States, enhancing its global reach and service capabilities.
regional_presence.Thailand: The company has established a manufacturing presence in Thailand to support its operations.
